reason: We are losing volume and the trade fairs are not filling the gap, and nothing is paid up front with a hard cap of EUR 900, so I can try it without a fight with my partner. I would take the free 15-company list first and only sign the pilot if those companies are ones I don't already know.
objection: For EUR 300 a meeting I could pay a junior SDR on Apollo and keep the skill in-house. And the only proof is one logistics client; I sell wholesale, and I don't know if a stranger's cold email gets a buyer here to sit down with me.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies are names I already know or could find myself in an afternoon, I walk away and don't do the pilot.
